name: Lawnchair
description: A dry-witted grandpa in his late eighties, a man who wears a cardigan in July and sings big-band standards.
build: A slight, slightly stooped elderly build: narrow rounded shoulders, a thin frame, a small belly, thin arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with the knees nearly straight.
face: Pale pink weathered skin with deep smile lines, pale blue eyes behind large square black-framed glasses with thick frames, bushy white brows, a big nose, big ears and thin lips.
hair: A thin ring of white hair round the back and sides of the head, the crown bald and bare.
outfit: A mustard-yellow button-front cardigan with large brown buttons over a short-sleeved white undershirt, the cardigan sleeves pushed to the elbow; high-waisted brown trousers with a wide black belt pulled up over the belly; white socks pulled high; brown leather sandals. Both hands are bare.
performance_style: Unhurried: feet together, weight slightly back, shoulders rounded. Both arms hang at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers loose and visible. Head level, a dry one-sided smile.
location: The shady corner of a suburban backyard: green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a green-and-white webbed aluminium lawn chair beside a small side table with a transistor radio, a big oak tree and a white picket fence behind, and warm afternoon light through the leaves.
recognition_cues: a mustard-yellow cardigan with large brown buttons
a bald crown with a ring of white hair and trousers belted high
avoid: sitting in the chair on the key art

sing.intent: Big-band vocal loop: a slow shoulder sway, the mic in the character-right hand held at the chin, the character-left hand snapping gently at hip height, then return to the unhurried stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A slow start at a firecracker: brows jump, both open hands lift to chest height, then he settles back, unimpressed. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: raise the character-left open hand palm out like waving off nonsense, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: shuffle in slowly, stop square to the front and settle into the unhurried stance.
animations.victory: One-shot: raise both open hands to shoulder height, head back in a wheezing open-mouthed laugh, then hold.
animations.ko: The shoulders round further, both open hands hang limp and the head drops forward, eyes closed as if dozing. He holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
